'''Renik ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he went into the [[Nightmare Lands]] on [[Voss]], where he went mad and had to be put down by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] individual.
